get.summary: SkyGuard's current state, feed health, aircraft, fixtures and warnings
get.description: Read-only. Includes the show's location, because the map needs it. `running` is false when the daemon hasn't updated its status recently. `held_channels` lists the channels being forced now, and `events` the last 20 blackout starts and ends.

get.summary: The icon FPP shows in its page header when SkyGuard has a warning

post.summary: Look up map positions for an address
post.description: Sends the address to nominatim.openstreetmap.org. Only called when the user presses Look up. A POST with a JSON body, so another website can't trigger it.

415.description: The address wasn't sent as JSON

429.description: Asked too soon after the last lookup

502.description: The lookup service couldn't be reached

requestBody.description: center_lat and center_lon together, and/or online_api_key. Null clears a value.

400.description: Not JSON, or a value isn't valid
